body:
**Moved in [0f6f2f7](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-go/commit/0f6f2f798afac67604e1acd223e9b3ac199dc151).** The nil-`doLog` explanation now sits beside the check in `excludes`, matching `evaluateFlag`’s exposure metadata default.
Verification and shared decision The diff changes comments only. Both existing cases—`older_experiment_with_default_doLog` and `ordinary_allocation`—pass. [D010](https://github.com/DataDog/ffe-system-test-data/blob/531e69f0b943e76d6f34144dbc1303a136febadf/contracts/experimentation-opt-out/decision-history.md#d010) retains the [existing decision](https://github.com/DataDog/openfeature-js-client/pull/423#discussion_r4344233354): valid UFC requires an explicit boolean. Go’s existing nil-field compatibility remains separate; this cleanup does not establish a fleet default. The linked history is maintained in the [central proof draft](https://github.com/DataDog/ffe-system-test-data/pull/55).
